name: switch
title: Switch
blurb: Accessible toggle switch built on Radix UI with smooth thumb animation.
description: Switch component built on Radix UI with sliding thumb animation and consistent styling. Supports disabled state and focus-visible.
use_when: Creating simple binary toggles like on/off, yes/no, or enable/disable controls.
avoid_when: When you need custom animations beyond the built-in thumb slide.
a11y: Built on Radix UI Switch with full keyboard support and focus-visible indicators.
